items.source: If you cannot rearrange your code as recommended above, Spring Boot’s Maven and Gradle plugins must be configured to produce a separate artifact that is suitable for use as a dependency. The executable archive cannot be used as a dependency as the executable jar format packages application classes in BOOT-INF/classes. This means that they cannot be found when the executable jar is used as a dependency.
items.translation: 如果无法按照上述建议重新组织代码，则必须配置 Spring Boot 的 Maven 和 Gradle 插件，以生成一个适合作为依赖使用的独立构件。 可执行归档不能用作依赖，因为可执行 jar 格式将应用程序类打包在BOOT-INF/classes中。 这意味着当可执行 jar 用作依赖时，无法找到这些类。

items.source: If you are building a jar, package the application’s classes and resources in a nested BOOT-INF/classes directory. If you are building a war, package the application’s classes in a nested WEB-INF/classes directory as usual.

items.source: The spring-boot-dependencies POM manages the versions of common dependencies. The Spring Boot plugins for Maven and Gradle allow these managed dependency versions to be customized using build properties.

items.source: Most nested libraries in an executable jar do not need to be unpacked in order to run. However, certain libraries can have problems. For example, JRuby includes its own nested jar support, which assumes that the jruby-complete.jar is always directly available as a file in its own right.
items.translation: 可执行 JAR 中大多数嵌套库无需解压即可运行。然而，某些库可能会出现问题。例如，JRuby 包含其自身的嵌套 JAR 支持，该支持假定 jruby-complete.jar 始终作为一个独立的文件直接可用。

items.source: To deal with any problematic libraries, you can flag that specific nested jars should be automatically unpacked when the executable jar first runs. Such nested jars are written beneath the temporary directory identified by the java.io.tmpdir system property.
items.translation: 为了解决任何有问题的库，您可以标记特定的嵌套 jar 在可执行 jar 首次运行时自动解压。 这些嵌套 jar 被写入由 java.io.tmpdir 系统属性标识的临时目录之下。

items.source: Often, if you have an executable and a non-executable jar as two separate build products, the executable version has additional configuration files that are not needed in a library jar. For example, the application.yaml configuration file might be excluded from the non-executable JAR.
items.translation: 通常，如果您将可执行文件和不可执行的 jar 作为两个独立的构建产物，可执行版本会包含一些在库 jar 中不需要的额外配置文件。例如，application.yaml 配置文件可能会被排除在非可执行的 JAR 之外。

Like a war file, a Spring Boot application is not intended to be used as a dependency.
If your application contains classes that you want to share with other projects, the recommended approach is to move that code into a separate module.
The separate module can then be depended upon by your application and other projects.

items.source: The commit time in git.properties is expected to match the following format: yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ssZ. This is the default format for both plugins listed above.
